steps.content:
July 25, N.F. 114
DisCity
[Background: Command HQ]

It has been over four months since the dark web threat first surfaced. After being initially caught off guard, the authorities have struck back, effectively controlling the situation and swiftly dealing with all types of emergencies.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We have established comprehensive technical cooperation with the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. The overall situation is under control, with various emergencies promptly addressed by a team of experts. Additionally, research on the new type of Mania is progressing in an orderly manner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, you've been rushing about on this case for so long. Now you can finally relax and take a break.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief! Over here! I found a great anime series, collector's edition!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Please forget about it. The recent snack order has already used up all the budget.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hella isn't here. Plus, Chief is loaded. We rarely take vacations, so let's splurge a little.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We also have patrol duties. Chief is still vigilant, so we shouldn't...
Strolling down the broad avenue with the Sinners, you feel no threat of danger or conspiracy. The girls' laughter is bright and carefree. Such long-awaited ease is indeed precious.
In retrospect, though the dark web had been a pain in the neck, it was nothing compared to the frenzied Black Ring battles. DisCity has indeed returned to peace.
The crowd bustles around you, basking in the summer sun. Everything is so peaceful, but you suddenly stop in your tracks.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief? Is anything wrong?
[Insert CG - glitch concept art]

A series of incomprehensible characters tear through your vision, inverting the colors before your eyes. Everything trembles and collides with each other, before breaking down into massive color blocks.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?! Chief, what's wrong?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh? An attack? What attack?!!
Rifts tear through the sky. Rays of light surge from the depths of the darkness, writhing to converge into some kind of monster.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Command received. Anomaly detection initiated...

You see waves of image noise forming into Corruptors, who quiver and distort upon closer scrutiny. A tidal wave of magnetic noise hits your brain. Your senses become blurred, yet your thoughts grow clearer. You make a decisive judgment...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's the dark web... A huge scale Mania attack. Contact the Cybersecurity Center immediately...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a huge scale anomaly...
[Shackles Effect]
You release the shackles with your last bit of strength, pointing in the direction of the attack. Hecate understands and looks in the same direction.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But Chief, where are the enemies?
The streets are still bustling, and the crowd teems without any hint of disturbance. The confused Sinners try anxiously to protect their dizzy Chief.
Above all the chaos, you see the sky vertically divided by a massive web of light, like an impenetrable ceiling formed by countless searching eyes.

<size=72>This chaotic, manic storm
has no impact on true fate.</size>
